# PpdsDbCommand

- Namespace/type: `PPDS.Query.Provider.PpdsDbCommand`
- Assembly: `PPDS.Query`

## Summary

ADO.NET command that executes SQL against Dataverse via the PPDS query engine. Parses SQL with PPDS.Query.Parsing.QueryParser, builds an execution plan with PPDS.Query.Planning.ExecutionPlanBuilder, and executes it with PPDS.Dataverse.Query.Execution.PlanExecutor.
